slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Exod 17:6: Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.
slides.body: “Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.”
slides.heading: Exod 17:6

slides.alt_text: Slide 2: Paul says the rock was Christ God gives Israel water from a rock in the desert. Paul later says the spiritual rock that travelled with them “was Christ.”
slides.body: God gives Israel water from a rock in the desert. Paul later says the spiritual rock that travelled with them “was Christ.”
slides.heading: Paul says the rock was Christ

slides.alt_text: Slide 3: Why Christians connect them God stands by the rock, and the story asks whether the LORD is with Israel. Christians read Paul as saying Christ was God’s presence with them.
slides.body: God stands by the rock, and the story asks whether the LORD is with Israel. Christians read Paul as saying Christ was God’s presence with them.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Slide 4: But Exodus is not a forecast Exodus describes water supplied during an emergency. It never names a future saviour or says the stone travelled with Israel. Paul gives the story a Christian meaning later.
slides.body: Exodus describes water supplied during an emergency. It never names a future saviour or says the stone travelled with Israel. Paul gives the story a Christian meaning later.
slides.heading: But Exodus is not a forecast

title: Paul says the rock was Christ
